name: Richard Lewis Arnowitt
summary: Theoretical physicist known for contributions to current algebra, effective Lagrangians, and supergravity grand unification.

name: Pran Nath
summary: Theoretical physicist and collaborator of Richard Arnowitt at Northeastern University.

name: Marvin Friedman
summary: Physicist who collaborated with Arnowitt and Nath on effective Lagrangians and current algebra.

name: Ali Chamseddine
summary: Physicist who collaborated on supergravity grand unification and completed a Ph.D. at Imperial College.

name: Northeastern University
summary: University in Boston where Pran Nath worked and collaborated with Arnowitt.

name: Texas A&M University
summary: University that hosted the Memorial Symposium in honor of Richard Arnowitt.

name: CERN
summary: European particle physics laboratory where Pran Nath took sabbatical leave in 1980.

name: Imperial College, London
summary: University where Ali Chamseddine completed his Ph.D. thesis.

name: Boston
summary: City where Northeastern University is located and where Chamseddine arrived in 1981.

name: London
summary: City where the XVII ICHEP Conference was held in 1974.

name: College Station
summary: City in Texas where the Memorial Symposium was held.

name: Effective Lagrangian Method
summary: Theoretical technique developed by Arnowitt, Friedman, and Nath for mesonic vertices.

name: Gauge Supersymmetry
summary: Theory formulated by Arnowitt and Nath extending Einstein gravity to superspace geometry.

name: Supergravity Grand Unification
summary: Phenomenologically viable model developed by Arnowitt, Nath, and Chamseddine involving gravity mediated breaking.
